senses.gloss: (b. h.; cmp. גלח a. גרע)to scratch off, rub; lay open.
to be opened through rubbing or scratching, to bleed.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Niddah 8:2">Nidd. VIII, 2</cite> (<cite ref="Niddah 58b:15">58ᵇ</cite>) <he>והיא יכולה להִגָּלֵעַ וכ׳</he> (Bart. <he>להתגלע</he>) and it (the wound) may have been bruised so as to bleed.

senses.gloss: (with ב of person) to detract from, lay bare the ignorance of, attack. Y. Yeb. VIII, end, 9ᵈ משום שלא לגְרוֹעַ בו וכ׳ (did they send him off) in order not to see him exposed, or because he was not fit (to argue)? What is the difference? היה דרכו לגַלֵּע א״ת משום שלא לגלע בו וכ׳ It was his (Rabbi’s) habit to begin with vehement argument; now, if you were to say, ‘in order not to see him exposed’, his exposure was in his own hand (he being the attacking part) &c.
units: Ib. מה היה לו לגַ׳ בו what could he have attacked (on that subject of androgynos)?

<cite ref="Sanhedrin 6b">Snh. 6ᵇ</cite>; Y. ib. I, 18ᵇ (ref. to <cite ref="Proverbs 17:14">Prov. XVII, 14</cite>) (<he>עד שלא נתג׳</he>) <he>קודם שנתג׳ הריב נטוש</he> before the case of litigation has been laid open (fully argued), you (the judge) may compromise it &c.; Tanḥ.
<cite ref="Exodus 6">Mishp. 6</cite>; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 956">Yalk. Prov. 956</cite> <cite ref="C00926"><he>נִתְגַּלֶּה</he></cite>, <he>יִתְגַּלֶּה</he>).
